description: Base case: estimates as recorded, auditor relies on system-generated evidence after testing it, all products from year 1, undiscounted
Maintenance 50% above estimate (common for internal tooling)
Auditor does not rely on internally generated evidence; manual evidence preparation added to automated alternatives
Downside: auditor non-reliance and maintenance 50% above estimate
Additional products adopt only from year 3
Base case discounted at 8% per year

Owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F planning case: auditor reliance not assumed; no fractional independent reviewer or external technical validation purchased. Examinations and penetration testing stay in as conservative cost provisions (charged on the model's standard timing), pending reassessment against actual obligations; they are not committed or required by this scenario.

ODP-09 no examination: no SOC examination is commissioned and no auditor-specific packaging is prepared; no contracted reviewer or external technical validation (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F). Penetration testing and customer diligence stay as provisions.

ODP-09 partial reliance: an examination is commissioned and the examiner relies on about half of the system-generated evidence; half the manual non-reliance evidence preparation is charged. External technical validation of the assurance machinery is included because an examiner relying on system evidence would need it (ACT-045, ACT-071); no contracted reviewer.

ODP-09 full reliance: an examination is commissioned and the examiner relies on system-generated evidence after testing it. External technical validation of the assurance machinery is included because an examiner relying on system evidence would need it (ACT-045, ACT-071); no contracted reviewer.

ODP-09 customer-specific (a sensitivity of S9, not a separate model): no SOC examination; customers receive generated answers and evidence packages directly, represented only by doubling customer-packaging effort (hypothetical). The model has no customer-count dimension, customer-mandated tests or audit-rights assessments; those are recorded as limitations.
